title: When Complementary Measurements Count the Same Classical Bit Twice: Counterexamples to CQC, ECQC, and Complementarity-Based Certification
summary: Mutually unbiased measurements are commonly expected to expose independent facets of a quantum state: a correlation that is classical in one basis should disappear in a complementary basis. In higher dimensions, however, this intuition becomes particularly subtle because correlations recovered in different settings need not represent different information.
